articles.title: What Is QUALCOMM (QCOM) Signaling With Its New AI PC OS Partnership?
articles.description: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) is working with Kora Systems on a new Linux-based AI desktop operating system tuned for Snapdragon chips. Kora Systems, founded by Cyanogen co-founder Kirt McMaster, unveiled the AI focused desktop OS for Snapdragon powered PCs. The platform is built around on device AI workloads, aligning with Qualcomm's push into AI capable personal computers beyond smartphones. This new Kora Systems Linux AI OS for Snapdragon PCs is only one piece of what is changing for Qualcomm...
